name: Russian CEE Kinetic and Sabotage Campaign
summary: Russian hybrid operations resulted in the sinking of the container ship ContShip Jet off Bulgaria and lethal ballistic and jet-drone attacks across Ukrainian transit centers, while proxy sabotage networks continue targeting NATO industrial infrastructure.

name: Volt Typhoon Silent Train Network
summary: Chinese state-sponsored espionage cluster utilizing disposable, multi-hop SOHO/IoT proxy chains to breach critical infrastructure and exploit Cisco SD-WAN appliances for control plane secrets.

name: AdFection Mercenary Spyware Campaign
summary: Mercenary spyware actors exploiting CoreGraphics (CVE-2026-86950) to target media and civil society; Apple backports fixes to older OS versions to mitigate the threat.

name: PHP2Shell Global Remote Code Execution Wave
summary: Global exploitation of PHP multipart/form-data heap corruption; threat actors observed chaining PHP2Shell to attack perimeter firewalls and enterprise web services.

name: HTTP2Shell / Node2Shell Brotli RCE Wave
summary: Mass exploitation of Google Brotli library (CVE-2026-111497); threat actors targeting enterprise web gateways and web application infrastructures.

name: North Korean Agentic AI Cyber Espionage Operations
summary: North Korean APT groups (Jade Sleet, Onyx Sleet, Coral Sleet, Pearl Sleet) adopt the ARTEX agentic framework and generative AI tooling to rapidly deploy fake front companies, synthesize phishing lures, and trojanize source code repositories.

name: SafePay Double-Extortion Campaign
summary: Ransomware operation targeting critical infrastructure globally; joint FBI/CISA/USSS advisory confirms compromises of over 600 organizations.

name: ConnectWise Cloud Backup M365 Supply Chain Breach
summary: Chinese state-sponsored group Storm-0940 compromised ConnectWise Cloud Backup via password spraying and the open-source ARTEX agentic framework.

name: Armory Castle Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Chinese state-sponsored espionage group Armory Castle weaponizes BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day CVE-2026-102764.

name: PEERSTITCH Fortinet Edge Exploitation Wave
summary: Threat actors exploited FortiManager CVE-2024-47575 to exfiltrate configs, deploying stealth in-memory malware PEERSTITCH.

name: GhostAction CI/CD Credential Exfiltration Wave
summary: Supply chain compromise spanning GitHub repositories, using malicious workflows to deliver infostealers and siphon cloud credentials.

name: Gheist GitHub Actions Log Exfiltration Campaign
summary: Automated threat cluster harvesting stolen GitHub tokens to plant malicious workflows that print private repository secrets into logs.

name: APT28 European Defense Espionage Campaign
summary: Russian GRU (APT28) executing targeted intrusions against NATO naval shipbuilders and military aircraft engine manufacturers.

name: Operation FlashHole Financial PKI Abuse
summary: Lazarus Group campaign weaponizing mandatory South Korean PKI financial security software INISAFE CrossWeb EX.

name: ROMULUS ClickFix Malware Delivery Cluster
summary: Malware delivery service deploying ClickFix lures via compromised landing pages and fake Cloudflare verification prompts to deliver infostealers.
